title: How to A/B Test with Nginx (split_clients, Sticky Cookies, and Variant Logging)
description: To A/B test with Nginx, use split_clients "${remote_addr}${http_user_agent}" $variant { 50% "a"; * "b"; } in the http block, then route each variant to a different root or upstream and log $variant in your access log. This guide covers sticky cookies, targeting users by device, country, or language, measuring conversions from logs, and avoiding SEO and caching mistakes.
author: greencrew

title: How to Add Security Headers in Nginx (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, and More)
description: To add security headers in Nginx, use add_header with the always flag, for example add_header Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains" always; put them in a shared snippet so add_header inheritance doesn't drop them, then reload and verify with curl -I. This guide covers HSTS, Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options, frame protection, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy.
author: greencrew

title: How to Configure PHP-FPM with Nginx (fastcgi_pass, Unix Socket, and Pool Tuning)
description: To run PHP with Nginx, install php-fpm, then add a location ~ \.php$ block that includes snippets/fastcgi-php.conf and sets fastcgi_pass unix:/run/php/php-fpm.sock. This guide covers the full server block, pool settings like pm.max_children, the status page, and fixes for 502, 504, and "File not found" errors.
author: greencrew

title: How to Create a Self-Signed SSL Certificate for Nginx (openssl Command, Nginx Config, and Trusting It)
description: To create a self-signed certificate for Nginx, run openssl req -x509 -nodes -days 365 -newkey rsa:2048 -keyout nginx-selfsigned.key -out nginx-selfsigned.crt with a subjectAltName, then point ssl_certificate and ssl_certificate_key at the files in a listen 443 ssl server block. This guide covers the full config, the HTTP-to-HTTPS redirect, trusting the certificate on Linux and macOS, mkcert, and fixing browser errors.
author: greencrew

title: How to Enable Gzip and Brotli Compression in Nginx (and Verify It Works)
description: Enable gzip in Nginx with gzip on, gzip_comp_level 5, gzip_proxied any, gzip_vary on, and a gzip_types list for CSS, JavaScript, JSON, and SVG. Add Brotli with the ngx_brotli module, then verify with curl -H "Accept-Encoding: br" -I. A copy-paste config, a compression level table, and fixes for when compression doesn't work.
author: greencrew

title: How to Fix 502 Bad Gateway in Nginx (Error Log Messages, Causes, and Fixes)
description: To fix a 502 Bad Gateway in Nginx, run sudo tail -n 50 /var/log/nginx/error.log, find the upstream error (connection refused, permission denied, upstream sent too big header), and fix the backend, port, socket, or buffer setting it points to. This guide maps every common error log message to its cause and a copy-paste fix.
author: greencrew

title: How to Get Website Downtime Alerts on Discord, Slack, and Telegram
description: To get website downtime alerts on Discord, Slack, or Telegram, create a Discord or Slack incoming webhook (or a Telegram bot token and chat ID), test it with a single curl command, then connect it to an external uptime monitor that checks your site every minute. Includes setup steps, curl tests, and alerting best practices.
author: greencrew

title: How to Install a Free Let's Encrypt SSL Certificate on Nginx with Certbot (and Auto-Renew It)
description: Install Certbot with snap, run sudo certbot --nginx -d example.com -d www.example.com, then confirm auto-renewal with sudo certbot renew --dry-run. A step-by-step Ubuntu guide with renewal troubleshooting, rate limits, wildcard certificates, and SSL expiry monitoring.
author: greencrew

title: How to Install Nginx on Ubuntu (apt install nginx, UFW Firewall, and Your First Server Block)
description: To install Nginx on Ubuntu, run sudo apt update && sudo apt install nginx, allow web traffic with sudo ufw allow 'Nginx Full', and check it with systemctl status nginx and curl -I http://localhost. This guide also covers server blocks, the config file layout, the official nginx.org repository, service commands, and common install errors.
author: greencrew

title: How to Set Up Nginx Load Balancing with Failover (upstream, least_conn, and Health Checks)
description: To load balance with Nginx, list your backend servers in an upstream block, choose a method such as least_conn, set max_fails=3 fail_timeout=30s for passive health checks, and send traffic with proxy_pass http://backend. Covers failover with backup servers, sticky sessions, retries, and monitoring each backend.
author: greencrew

title: How to Set Up Nginx Caching with proxy_cache (Config, Cache Bypass, and Serving Stale Content)
description: To set up Nginx caching, define a cache with proxy_cache_path /var/cache/nginx/app levels=1:2 keys_zone=app_cache:10m max_size=1g inactive=60m; in the http block, then add proxy_cache app_cache; and proxy_cache_valid 200 10m; to your proxied location. This guide covers the full config, cache bypass for logged-in users, microcaching, serving stale content when the backend is down, and purging.
author: greencrew

title: How to Set Up Nginx as a Reverse Proxy (proxy_pass Config, Headers, and Health Checks)
description: To set up Nginx as a reverse proxy, add a server block with proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:3000, forward the Host and X-Forwarded-* headers, run nginx -t, and reload. Includes a copy-paste config, WebSocket support, timeouts, a health check endpoint, and uptime monitoring.
author: greencrew

title: How to Set Up Rate Limiting in Nginx (limit_req, burst, and 429 Responses)
description: To rate limit in Nginx, define a zone with limit_req_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=perip:10m rate=10r/s in the http block, apply it with limit_req zone=perip burst=20 nodelay, and return 429 with limit_req_status 429. Copy-paste configs for login pages, APIs, allowlists, connection limits, and safe testing.
author: greencrew
